channel.title: Lodge
channel.description: Updates for Lodge, the SD card offloader for macOS.

item.description:
## Lodge 1.0.2
- **New:** choose which days to offload (Any date, Today, Last 7 days or a custom range); files are judged by when they were recorded. - Disk images (.dmg) on a card are now ignored. - The installer shows the new Lodge icon.

## Lodge 1.0.1
**Coming from 1.0.0?** Lodge 1.0.0 can't check for updates, so download 1.0.1 by hand once: unzip it, then open the DMG and drag Lodge to Applications. From 1.0.1 on, Lodge updates itself.
### New
- **Menu bar mode.** Keep Lodge running in the menu bar after you close the window. It watches for camera cards and asks to import them, with a notification or a floating panel (Settings ▸ General). - **First-launch setup.** A short guide walks you through your first preset: destination, folders, naming and safety. - **A folder for each file type.** Inside the last folder, files are sorted into one folder per extension (MP4, WAV, ARW…). JPG and JPEG share one folder. - **Check for Updates.** Lodge ▸ Check for Updates…, plus automatic checks you can turn off in Settings ▸ General. - **Support Lodge.** A tip link in the Lodge and Help menus, and a short note that shows up at most twice. - **Contact.** bashframes contact details in About Lodge and the Help menu. - **Also new:** a new app icon, an expandable Layout tree, and a progress strip in the offload bar.
### Fixes
- The window title no longer reappears when the toolbar changes. - Other small fixes.
